document.description: US permanent residence document privileges verified against destination government sources

unlocks.conditions: Document proving permanent residence in the United States; visit for tourism, business or other activities without remuneration in Mexico
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Valid passport or identity and travel document. Present proof of US permanent residence. Immigration authorities may request the purpose of travel, itinerary, accommodation, funds and return or onward travel evidence.

source.verificationPath: INM > Paises y regiones que requieren visa para viajar a Mexico > alternative documents > item a) permanent residence
source.exactQuote: Documento que acredite residencia permanente en Canadá, Estados Unidos de América

unlocks.notes: Visa exemption for visitors without permission to perform remunerated activities. The INM page states a maximum of 180 days; the authorized stay and admission are determined by the immigration authority. This entry concerns permanent residence, separately from the valid-visa exemption in item b).
